title: Induction of Alopecia Areata in C3H/HeJ Mice via Cultured Cell Transfer
protocol: Euthanize the donor mice using institution-approved procedures.
Clean mouse skin with 70% ethanol.
Dissect the mice from the ventral side using surgical scissors and forceps.
Excise the inguinal, auxiliary, and cervical skin-draining lymph nodes with forceps or scissors.
Trim away extra fat and connective tissues from the lymph nodes.
Place trimmed skin-draining lymph nodes into complete AR10 medium and keep on ice.
Work in a biosafety cabinet using aseptic techniques.
Fill a small petri dish with 1 mL of 1x DPBS.
Remove lymph nodes from AR10 and transfer into DPBS to wash by brief rinsing.
In another clean petri dish, add 1 mL of fresh AR10 and place a 70 µm cell strainer in the middle of the dish.
Pick up the lymph nodes with forceps and transfer them into the center of the cell strainer.
Use the plunger end of a syringe to gently grind the lymph nodes against the cell strainer for about 5 minutes.
Pipette 1 mL of fresh AR10 and rinse the bottom of the cell strainer to wash the extra LNCs into the petri dish.
Remove the cell strainer and transfer all of the LNC suspension into a clean 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Wash the petri dish with another 1 mL of fresh AR10 and transfer into the centrifuge tube.
Top up centrifuge tube to 10 mL with another 7 mL of fresh AR10, pipette thoroughly but gently to wash the LNC suspension.
Take out 10 µL and count the cell number with a hemocytometer and trypan blue.
Calculate the total number of cells.
Determine how many cells will be used for expansion based on the calculated total number of cells.
Prepare complete medium AR10 with cytokines to resuspend the cell pellet into 2 million cells/mL.
Centrifuge the LNC suspension for 5 minutes at 350x g at room temperature.
Remove the supernatant carefully leaving the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet to 2 million cells/mL with AR10 supplemented with cytokines.
Pipette 1 mL of LNC suspension into a 24-well, non-tissue culture treated plate until desired number of wells are filled.
Place the 24-well plates in the 37 ºC incubator with 5% CO2.
Prepare dynabead mixture and resuspend well.
Take out the 24-well plates from the incubator.
Add 500 µL of dynabead mixture into each well of the plate.
Transfer the plate back into 37 ºC incubator with 5% CO2.
Check the culture daily but do not disturb the LNC suspension.
Split each well to two by gently resuspending the culture and pipetting 750 μL to an adjacent well.
Add 750 μL of AR10 supplemented with cytokines so each well contains 1.5 mL.
Combine 2x wells into 1x T25 flask and add 3 mL of AR10 supplemented with cytokines.
Combine 2x T25 flasks into 1x T75 flask and add 8 mL of AR10 supplemented with cytokines.
Combine the LNC suspension in T75 flasks into 50 mL centrifuge tube(s).
Place a clean round bottom centrifuge tube into an EasySep magnet or similar.
Transfer LNCs suspension into the centrifuge tube to a level at the same height as the magnet and let it set for 1 minute.
Gently pipette the LNC suspension from the centrifuge tube to a clean 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Repeat steps until removal of all dynabeads from all LNC suspension has been achieved.
Take 10 μL and count the number of cells with a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the LNC suspension for 5 minutes at 350x g at room temperature.
Remove the supernatant from the LNC pellet and resuspend into 10 million cells/100 μL with sterile PBS.
Draw the resuspended LNC suspension into insulin syringe\(s) or similar and keep on ice.
Anesthetize the recipient mice using isoflurane or similar following standardized protocols provided by the local institution.
Shave a small area on the lower back of the mice to expose an area of skin for intra-dermal injection.
Gently pinch up a section of the skin with a pair of blunt forceps and insert the syringe needle almost parallel to the plane of the skin pinched up by the forceps, into the dermis layer.
Inject 100 μl of LNC suspension slowly into the skin.
Retract the syringe, but use forceps to hold the skin for a few seconds.
Transfer injected mice back to their cage without pressing on the injection site.
Repeat steps for injecting all mice.
Continue to feed mice with a low-fat diet.
